items.title: Freeze the M0 drivability baseline fixture contract
items.context: Record a stable regression fixture contract for the rule-free fix-git run: baseline commands-to-DEV is 80+ commands and never reached DEV; the fixture must define what is measured and how future M6 comparison reports are interpreted without treating an agent narrative as proof.
items.userSees: A future maintainer can identify the exact baseline metric and fixture contract before changing INIT guidance.
excludes: Do not run the full autonomous fix-git experiment in this story unless a lightweight deterministic fixture already exists.
Do not change any lifecycle evidence requirement.

happy.desc: M0 baseline contract records commands-to-DEV baseline as 80+ commands and never reached DEV, plus comparison rules for future M6 runs.

edge.desc: Baseline wording does not treat agent transcript narration as proof and distinguishes M0 baseline from M6 execution results.

adversarial.desc: No text implies that M0 or init_preflight can satisfy lifecycle gates, production readiness, or reviewer evidence.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n '80\+ commands|never reached DEV|Future comparisons|M0 is baseline documentation' docs/requirements/decisions/pos-agent-drivability-optimization.md
verificationEvidence.note: Decision doc records the frozen M0 baseline contract: 80+ commands, never reached DEV, plus future comparison fields.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'not gate evidence|not product proof|Future comparisons|agent narration' docs/requirements/decisions/pos-agent-drivability-optimization.md
verificationEvidence.note: M0 wording distinguishes baseline documentation from runtime proof and future M6 execution results.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'not gate evidence|without relaxing any gate evidence|not a basis for relaxing review' docs/requirements/decisions/pos-agent-drivability-optimization.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document explicitly avoids claiming M0/init_preflight satisfies lifecycle gates or production readiness.

items.title: Route session_brief and next INIT guidance to init_preflight
items.context: Update INIT-phase next-step logic so session_brief / next point agents to lattice init_preflight --storyId=<id> before story_advance INIT_CHECK. Preserve non-git guidance and read-only behavior.
items.userSees: For an INIT story, lattice session_brief and lattice next tell the agent to run init_preflight instead of blindly attempting story_advance INIT_CHECK.
excludes: Do not auto-run init_preflight from session_brief.
Do not write evidence or advance phase.

happy.desc: For an INIT story, session_brief and next render lattice init_preflight --storyId=<id> as the next diagnostic step before story_advance INIT_CHECK.

edge.desc: Non-git INIT guidance remains intact and does not claim init_preflight can create a worktree or write evidence.

adversarial.desc: The guidance does not auto-run init_preflight, write evidence, or imply reviewer/scope gates are optional.

verificationEvidence.note: INIT next-step/session guidance now points to init_preflight before INIT_CHECK advancement.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'read-only; it does not write evidence or create worktrees' packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Session guidance preserves read-only behavior and does not claim init_preflight creates a worktree or writes evidence.
Guidance names init_preflight as diagnostics first and still requires story_advance after READY; no auto-run or gate bypass.

items.title: Route story_create and global help INIT flow through init_preflight
items.context: Update story_create INIT hint and the global lattice --help development-flow block so agents see the full INIT prerequisite route before story_advance INIT_CHECK.
items.userSees: Freshly created INIT stories and top-level help no longer advertise a direct INIT_CHECK jump without preflight guidance.
excludes: Do not implement M2 checklist self-seeding in this story.
Do not alter unrelated help sections.

happy.desc: story_create success guidance and the global development-flow help mention init_preflight before direct INIT_CHECK advancement.

edge.desc: The updated help still keeps the normal worktree path visible after prerequisites are ready and does not rewrite unrelated help sections.

adversarial.desc: No help text suggests checklist self-seeding, parser repairs, scope-plan dispatch, global-thin asset repair, or ceremony redesign are included in this M1 story.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js --help | rg -n 'init_preflight|After preflight READY' && rg -n 'Before story_advance, run lattice init_preflight' packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Global help and story_create guidance mention init_preflight before direct INIT_CHECK advancement.
Help keeps the normal worktree path visible after init_preflight is READY.
Help change is limited to INIT routing and does not advertise M2-M7 behavior as part of this slice.

items.title: Add INIT_CHECK failure guidance toward init_preflight without weakening gates
items.context: When the INIT_CHECK gate fails on the first missing prerequisite, append exact guidance to run init_preflight so the agent can see all missing prerequisites. Keep evaluateScopeAntiExpansionGate fail-closed unless a separate structural story changes aggregation.
items.userSees: A failed story_advance INIT_CHECK points to init_preflight and controlled init_check_repair guidance where relevant, without implying any evidence exemption.
excludes: Do not bypass dual INIT reviewers.
Do not auto-exempt by task size or risk.
Do not implement M7 ceremony redesign.

happy.desc: A failed INIT_CHECK advancement on missing prerequisites includes exact guidance to run lattice init_preflight --storyId=<id> so all missing prerequisites are visible.

edge.desc: Existing fail-closed scope anti-expansion behavior remains intact unless a later structural story changes aggregation.

adversarial.desc: The failure guidance does not bypass dual INIT reviewers, auto-exempt by task size/risk, or claim production/full completion.

verificationEvidence.note: Regression test asserts missing scope/init-check INIT_CHECK failures include exact init_preflight guidance.
Test covers fail-closed scope-boundary, execution-boundary, scope-freeze, missing init-check, and missing reviewer cases.
Failure guidance adds diagnostics only and preserves reviewer/freeze gates; no auto-exemption or readiness claim.

items.title: Add focused tests for M1 routing behavior
items.context: Add or update focused tests/smokes that assert INIT session guidance, story_create hint, global help flow, and INIT_CHECK failure guidance name init_preflight and do not claim readiness or production completion.
items.userSees: The M1 routing fixes are protected against regression by machine checks rather than relying on prose review.
excludes: Do not require network or real external hosts.
Do not depend on hidden scorer state.

happy.desc: Focused tests or smokes assert that session guidance, story_create/global help guidance, and INIT_CHECK failure guidance name init_preflight.

edge.desc: Tests avoid brittle full-help snapshots and assert only the relevant routing and no-overclaim language.

adversarial.desc: Tests fail if new output claims init_preflight writes evidence, launches reviewers, advances phase, or grants production/readiness authority.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused tests cover INIT gate guidance, scope-plan dispatch, and ledger-backed checklist_add UX.
Tests use targeted assertions instead of broad brittle full-output snapshots.
Tests assert dispatch output is not gate evidence and init_preflight remains diagnostic guidance.

items.title: Add story-level scope-plan reviewer dispatch
items.context: Fix the documented #6 blocker from pos-agent-drivability: lattice dispatch currently requires itemId/findingId/clusterId except INIT reviewers, so a story-level lattice-review-scope-plan reviewer cannot get a prompt that terminates in scope_check_save. Add the minimal story-level dispatch branch and prompt builder needed for scope-plan reviewer evidence.
items.userSees: A PLAN story can run lattice dispatch with storyId and agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan and receive a reviewer prompt that tells the reviewer to call scope_check_save.
excludes: Do not let the main implementation agent self-sign scope_check_save.
Do not implement open-question resolution UX beyond the existing scope_question_resolve command.
Do not implement full M4 beyond the minimal story-level scope-plan dispatch blocker.

happy.desc: lattice dispatch with storyId and agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan succeeds without itemId and returns a prompt for story-level PLAN scope review ending in scope_check_save.

edge.desc: Existing item-scoped reviewer dispatch and INIT reviewer dispatch behavior remain unchanged.

adversarial.desc: The new path does not allow the main implementation agent to self-sign scope evidence and does not treat dispatch output as gate evidence until scope_check_save is written by the reviewer lane.

verificationEvidence.note: Story-level lattice-review-scope-plan dispatch works without itemId and prompt ends in scope_check_save guidance.
The new branch is separate from INIT reviewer and item-scoped dispatch behavior; existing branches remain intact.
Test asserts dispatch does not create scope-check evidence and missing_scope_check still requires reviewer-written scope_check_save.

items.title: Warn when checklist_add may require milestone ledger sync
items.context: Small drivability bug found while adding CHK-006: checklist_add can append a requirement on a story that already has a milestone ledger, but the command output does not surface that milestone_ledger_add or ledger update may be needed, so milestone_status can appear to omit the new work.
items.userSees: After checklist_add on a story with an existing milestone ledger, the terminal includes "Milestone ledger exists; if this item changes milestone coverage, update the ledger with lattice milestone_ledger_add".
excludes: Do not auto-create milestone rows from checklist text
Do not change milestone_status read-only projection semantics
Do not weaken ProofStory ledger confirmation or DONE gates

happy.desc: checklist_add on a story with an existing milestone ledger prints a clear milestone ledger sync hint naming lattice milestone_ledger_add.

edge.desc: checklist_add on a story without a milestone ledger keeps the existing checklist-derived flow and does not imply a ledger is required.

adversarial.desc: The hint does not auto-create milestone rows, does not mark milestones covered, and does not change milestone_status from read-only projection to mutation.

verificationEvidence.note: Ledger-backed checklist_add prints the milestone-ledger sync advisory naming lattice milestone_ledger_add.
No-ledger path keeps the existing checklist-derived flow and does not imply a milestone ledger is required.
Test snapshots milestone-ledger.json before checklist_add and verifies checklist_add does not mutate it.

items.title: Force milestone ledger status display during development UX
items.context: When a story already has a milestone ledger, developers should see the live read-only milestone status during normal development/planning command output, not only when manually running milestone_status or on narrow mutation commands. Current CLI has MILESTONE_STATUS_APPEND_COMMANDS, but it omits checklist_add and likely misses common DEV visibility surfaces, so ledger-backed work can feel invisible in the UX.
items.userSees: For a ledger-backed story, common development command output includes "Milestone Status - <storyId>" automatically, with the read-only disclaimer, without requiring a separate milestone_status command.
excludes: Do not make milestone_status a gate pass or production-readiness claim
Do not auto-update milestone rows
Do not append milestone status to machine JSON output
Do not hide render failures silently

happy.desc: For a ledger-backed active DEV story, common developer commands such as checklist_add append a visible Milestone Status - <storyId> block automatically.

edge.desc: Machine JSON output is not polluted by forced milestone status, and stories without a milestone ledger still use the existing checklist-derived or no-ledger behavior without fabricated milestone rows.

adversarial.desc: A milestone_status render failure remains visible as a display failure and does not imply the preceding command failed or that milestone data was changed.

verificationEvidence.note: Ledger-backed checklist_add output automatically includes the Milestone Status block.
Existing milestone-status regression coverage keeps machine JSON clean and preserves no-ledger checklist-derived behavior.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:milestone-status && lattice scope_contract_check --storyId=B-90d6
verificationEvidence.note: Render-failure visibility and scope status remain non-mutating; scope gate is warn-only for acknowledged metadata, not a hidden pass.
